description: This file defines the access control handler class for the menu link content entity type in Drupal, managing permissions for viewing, updating, and deleting menu links.

classes.name: MenuLinkContentAccessControlHandler
classes.description: Defines the access control handler for menu link content entities, extending Drupal's EntityAccessControlHandler and implementing EntityHandlerInterface to manage permissions for menu link operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the access manager for route permission checks.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the access control handler, retrieving the access manager service from the container.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks user permissions for view, update, and delete operations on menu link content entities, including route-based access control.
